title: Basis expanded generator density
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and nonzero $\ell$, the basis expanded small bias generator density is the probability density on $\mathbb{F}_2^{n\ell}$ obtained by applying the field pairing density construction to the basis expanded small bias field family.
caveat: The defining field pairing density and field family are not supplied.
